description: Taxonomic group as given in the input sheet (SKUPINA).
Family as given in the input sheet.
Taxon name exactly as in NDOP; records of other names returned by the query are excluded.
Proposed category from the rule engine: the best estimate (working scenario). A proposal, not a category: only an approved Final_Category is one.
values: LC, NT, VU, EN, CR, DD (candidate), RE (candidate), NE, NA; empty when no proposal was possible (see issue_*)

description: Criteria behind the proposal in ndopred's established format (e.g. B1ab(iii); B2ab(iii)), or the reason for NT, DD, RE or NE.
Comparison window (years) for changes and the reduction.
Current window (years) for EOO, AOO and the current occurrence.
AOO of the comparison window, 2 x 2 km grid, minimum over grid origins.
AOO of the current window: occupied 2 x 2 km cells x 4 km2, minimum over grid origins. The value used for criterion B2 and D2. Observed AOO is a lower bound of the true AOO.
EOO of the comparison window (minimum convex polygon, at least the AOO).
EOO of the current window: minimum convex polygon of the records, set to the AOO where smaller. The value used for criterion B1.
Distance clusters (5 km) in the comparison window. A spatial diagnostic, not the number of locations.
Distance clusters (5 km) in the current window. A spatial diagnostic, not the number of locations: locations are defined by threats and come from the evidence file (threat_locations).
Occupied 2 x 2 km cells in the current window (AOO / 4).
Raw change in AOO between the windows on one shared grid origin. Not corrected for recording effort; the trend the engine uses is Trend_Estimate.
Raw change in EOO (alpha-hull, alpha = 2, on occupied cells) between the windows. Not corrected for recording effort.
Usable records of the taxon, all years (after the exclusions in Records_Excluded).
Usable records in the current window.
Year of the most recent usable record.

Restricted enough for VU D2 (AOO below 20 km2, or at most 5 locations, clusters standing in as an indication) while the threat is not yet given; VU D2 needs a specified plausible threat from the evidence file. The 20 km2 and 5 are conventions (typical values in the Guidelines).
Link to the taxon's page on portal.nature.cz.
Criteria behind the proposal in IUCN Annex 2 notation (e.g. EN B1ab(ii,iii)+2ab(ii,iii)).
Whether every condition behind the proposal is evidenced, or some rest on indications from the records, or the proposal is only a candidate.
values: evidence, indication, candidate, none (app: doloženo, indikace z nálezových dat, kandidát, nehodnoceno)

description: What is still missing to close the assessment, per criterion.
Plausible range of categories: the low end with unknown conditions not met and areas at their largest, the high end with unknown conditions met and areas at their smallest.
TRUE when the plausible range holds a non-threatened and a threatened category (AOPK decision D7); the assessor decides with the risk tolerance.
Flags: uncertain range, DD candidate, D2 candidate, RE candidate and the like.
Place in the expert queue: 1 where CR or EN is possible (or an RE candidate), 2 where VU is possible (or a DD candidate), 3 for NT, 4 for an LC candidate, 0 to rerun. Empty for NA and NE.
The triage as text. An LC candidate has no criterion met even at the plausible maximum; it still needs an expert and is never LC automatically.
AOO of the current window on the display grid chosen in the app. For maps only; never used by the criteria.
Reference year of the run; all windows are fixed from it (the system clock is not read).
Lower bound of the current AOO from positional precision: uncertain records placed in occupied cells where they can be.
Upper bound of the current AOO from positional precision: each uncertain record in a cell of its own where it can be. Still a bound on the observed AOO only.
Lower bound of the current EOO from positional precision.
Upper bound of the current EOO from positional precision.
Records excluded by the record flags (different taxon, VEROH 6 or 9, negative finding, no position, outside Czechia, unparseable date). Excluded records are kept, never deleted.
Excluded records per reason.
File name of the NDOP snapshot the run used; rerunning on it gives the same result.
Generation length used for the time frames of A and C1 (10 years or 3 generations).
Where the generation length comes from: the group table (placeholder values until refined), the evidence file, or the default.
The final category, shown only when approved by the group experts; with the degree sign when the regional step adjusted it.
The final category entered in the evidence file, approved or not.
State of the final category.
values: no final category, awaiting approval, approved, approved; inconsistent with the evidence

description: Where the final category goes beyond what the evidence and data support alone.
The proposal after the regional step: step three may move it one category (or more) and adds the degree sign; NA when step one excludes the taxon.
Criteria of the regional category; unchanged by the step.
Trail of the regional procedure: eligibility (step one) and the answers to questions 3a-3f.
The global Red List category (and criteria) from the evidence file, published alongside the regional one.
Share of the global population in Czechia from the evidence file; '?' when unknown.
Data tier behind the trend: T0 records only, T1 effort proxy from the group's effort layer, T2 repeat visits (occupancy-detection model), T3 standardized counts.
The trend estimate the tier allows, with its 90 % interval. T0 is a raw change, not a trend. A reduction for criterion A only after an expert confirms it as evidence.
values: per cent (min to max); negative = decline

description: Why this tier was used, and the method behind the estimate (including the sample share of a sampled effort layer).
Range of the change when the start of the windows moves by up to two years.
Reason the download failed.
Reason there are no usable records.
Reason the AOO could not be computed.
Reason the EOO could not be computed, or that the AOO stands in for it.
Reason the clusters could not be computed.
Reason a window has no records or the trend could not be computed.
Reason the population metrics are missing or limited.
